trigger: DNS resolution or outbound fetch fails for exact required bytes
do_not: retry arbitrary mirrors proxies package managers or equivalent download commands
preferred_fallback: issue one exact user-Termux acquisition/analyzer wrapper with URL digest bounded analysis and result tar.zst

trigger: full Git history refs or object graph is required
do_not: reconstruct the repository through repeated raw connector reads
preferred_fallback: use a verified user-created full Git bundle and clone locally

trigger: search misses a known path commit or slash-containing ref
do_not: infer that the object is absent or repeat broad searches
preferred_fallback: read the exact path at an exact ref or use user-Termux Git and compare commit coordinates

trigger: a non-warmup upload rejects valid bytes because the supplied path or connector object violates the current action contract
do_not: repeat the same invalid call transform bytes weaken checksum verification or stop treating Drive as the primary exchange path
preferred_fallback: inspect the action contract once then expose identical bytes through a user-visible sandbox link or user rclone for the current delivery and attempt Drive first again for the next outbound artifact

trigger: the first upload attempted after the web-chat runtime is initialized or reset blocks local-path-to-file-reference rewrite even in an existing chat
do_not: repeat the blocked upload in the same delivery treat Drive as non-primary or assume the block persists for later uploads
preferred_fallback: expose the identical artifact through a user-visible sandbox link for the current delivery then attempt Drive first again on the next outbound upload while the runtime persists and verify SHA-256

trigger: a connector file reference is needed as a local path or a raw local path is passed where a connector object is required
do_not: guess a sandbox path or treat a reference as bytes
preferred_fallback: fetch or materialize explicitly and verify identity before local use

trigger: Android package loader GPU filesystem deployment or runtime fact is required
do_not: infer from sandbox state or label a synthetic test authoritative
preferred_fallback: issue the smallest self-contained Termux runner and review its structured result

trigger: shared /mnt/data performance or symlink/rename semantics differ from local execution
do_not: treat shared-storage behavior as Termux runtime truth
preferred_fallback: use local sandbox temporary storage for simulation and authoritative Termux execution for acceptance

trigger: a combined process receives timeout SIGTERM or loses its parent call
do_not: rerun the entire expensive sequence without inspecting state
preferred_fallback: inspect logs and process state then split bounded tests or use a persistent session with polling

trigger: container orchestration or Docker is proposed
preferred_fallback: use native shell Git isolated temporary directories and user Termux for device-only work

trigger: a new session lacks repository objects working tree or prior chat context
do_not: rely on narrative memory or reconstruct from connector fragments
preferred_fallback: start from a full Git bundle and repository START_HERE control plane
